note: English lines that teach Peppino's moves, rewritten for what these characters really do. The game's own line is used for every key not listed, and for other languages. Peppino in a line becomes the player's character.

rows.text: Press [J] to jump! You curl into a ball that breaks blocks and defeats enemies! Hold [D] and a direction to roll into low gaps!
You can break marble and metal blocks underneath you with a slam! Press [D] and [J] while in the air!
The ball destroys metal blocks too, so jump into them or slam down on them!
Some blocks may be hidden, keep an eye out for them! Press [G], or hit them as a ball, to destroy them!
Press [G] to do the Grab Dash! It can destroy marble blocks! A spindash works too: hold [D], tap [J], let go of [D]!
Hold [M] to boost! If you run into a wall while boosting, you will start wall running!
Press [J] while wall running to jump off the wall! Keep [M] held to stick on the other walls! Let go to drop off.
Press [G] then hold [M] for a quick start with the boost! Try it out!
You can also jump after pressing [G] in order to do a long jump!
You can also simply boost up a slope next to a wall to automatically start wall running!
While boosting, hold [D] to roll and destroy blocks in a small gap!
Release [D] and keep holding [M] to open the roll back up into a boost!
Press [D] and [J] in the air to drop straight down!
To run through metal blocks you need the speed of a long boost! Short of room? A ball breaks them at any speed.
To turn while keeping your boost, press the opposite direction and skid!
Your speed carries through the air, so try turning before you fall down a hole!
Hold [U] and press [J] to perform the Super Jump, at any speed! Let go of [U] to launch!
After starting a Super Jump, you can also dash forward in the air by pressing [G]! Give it a try!
Another trick: Press [G] then [D] immediately to go through gaps faster!
You can grab things with the Grab Dash and throw them by pressing [G] again!
If you hold [U] before throwing, you will send the things up!
Press [J] again in the air for your own move: Sonic's drop dash (hold it), Tails's flight, or Knuckles's glide (hold it, then climb the wall you hit)!
Did you know a spindash goes through enemy after enemy? It's the quickest way to keep your combo going.
An obscure technique: Press [D] and [J] in the air at any time to slam straight down. Only useful if you want to save time!
